newsitem.title: USA: GPU restores power to NJ users after storm.
newsitem.headline: GPU restores power to NJ users after storm.

text.p: GPU Energy, a subsidiary of GPU Inc, said Tuesday it restored service all its 78,000 customers in New Jersey whose service was disrupted by a fierce storm that swept across the state last Friday.
"Everyone was back by 11:30 (2330 EDT) last night," a GPU Energy spokeswoman said.
Majority of the affected customers lived in Morris, Hunterdon, Warren, Sussex and Somerset counties.
GPU said heavy wind and rain damaged local distribution lines and poles, and high-voltage transmission cables and transformers.
The storm caused operating trouble at GPU's Clinton substation Saturday but the problem was corrected the same day, the spokeswoman said.
Total damage from the storm was not immediately available, the GPU spokeswoman said.
GPU, headquartered in Parsippany, N.J., provides electric service to more than 900,000 customers across New Jersey.
